title: AETHER Electronics
summary: An electronics storefront connected to the tools that keep the business running.
challenge: An electronics business needs a clear way for customers to discover products and a dependable way for staff to manage what happens after an order.
solution: AETHER brings a public shopping experience and a private operations workspace into one connected product. The customer sees products and a simple cart; the team works with sales, stock, customers, suppliers, warranties and reporting behind the scenes.
journey: Explore the storefront and discover electronics by category.
Review a product and add it to the cart.
Continue the purchasing conversation with the business.
The team manages stock, sales, customers and after-sales records in its private workspace.
outcome: A connected product experience that demonstrates how a storefront and business operations can work together. The showcase currently includes sample products and content.

title: JMXR
summary: A digital home for a Nigerian luxury fashion brand.
challenge: Create an online presence that reflects the brand's ambition and gives customers a comfortable way to explore its world.
solution: A responsive brand website with deliberate typography, product presentation and a clear path from discovery to inquiry.
journey: Find the next step to connect or purchase.
outcome: A live digital flagship for the brand.

title: OSMOSIS
summary: A connected business space for entrepreneurs.
challenge: Small businesses often manage visibility, trade and operations through disconnected tools.
solution: A product concept bringing business profiles, commerce, payments and operational tools into one workspace.
journey: Explore connected tools as the platform develops.
outcome: An active product direction, presented as work in progress.
